title: cornutia coerulea
intro: Cornutia coerulea, commonly known as Blue Fringe Tree or Blue Fruited Cornutia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cornutia coerulea include acting as an expectorant, which helps in relieving congestion, and an antitussive, which helps in soothing coughs. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
